entities.summary: Fr. Domingos Chōhachi Nakamura [ドミンゴス中村長八] was a Catholic missionary and priest from the Diocese of Nagasaki (Japan). Nakamura worked as a priest for 26 years in Japan and 17 years in Brazil, where he died in 1940 with a reputation for holiness. He is now a Servant of God.
